draft.subject: Following up on our getting started call
draft.body:
Hi Jules,

Thanks for making time for the getting started call last week. Since then I wanted to check in on how things are going with Pioneer Ventures in Wrenfield.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting one real project in place is usually the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if that's helpful.

Would a short call this week work to get that first project set up together? Happy to work around your schedule.

Best,
Priya
